artifact.self_contained_problem:
Define the sequence of generalized central trinomial coefficients $T_n(b,c)$ for integers $b,c$ by
$$T_n(b,c) = [x^n]\,(x^2+bx+c)^n = \sum_{k=0}^{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}\binom{n}{2k}\binom{2k}{k}b^{n-2k}c^k.$$
For an odd prime $p$ and an integer $a$ coprime to $p$, let $\left(\tfrac{a}{p}\right)$ denote the Legendre symbol.

Prove or disprove the following two assertions for every prime $p>3$:

(I) Setting $S_1(p)=\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\dfrac{\binom{2k}{k}^2 T_{2k}(18,1)}{256^k}$, one has
$$S_1(p)\equiv\begin{cases}4x^2-2p\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{2}{p}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{5}\right)=1\text{ and }p=x^2+30y^2,\\ 12x^2-2p\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=1,\ \left(\tfrac{2}{p}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{5}\right)=-1\text{ and }p=3x^2+10y^2,\\ 2p-8x^2\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{2}{p}\right)=1,\ \left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{5}\right)=-1\text{ and }p=2x^2+15y^2,\\ 2p-6x^2\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{p}{5}\right)=1,\ \left(\tfrac{2}{p}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=-1\text{ and }2p=3x^2+10y^2,\\ 0\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{-30}{p}\right)=-1,\end{cases}$$
where $x,y$ are integers in the indicated representations.

(II) Setting $S_2(p)=\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\dfrac{\binom{2k}{k}^2 T_{2k}(30,1)}{256^k}$, one has
$$S_2(p)\equiv\begin{cases}4x^2-2p\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{-2}{p}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{7}\right)=1\text{ and }p=x^2+42y^2,\\ 12x^2-2p\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{-2}{p}\right)=1,\ \left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{7}\right)=-1\text{ and }p=3x^2+14y^2,\\ 2p-8x^2\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{p}{7}\right)=1,\ \left(\tfrac{-2}{p}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=-1\text{ and }p=2x^2+21y^2,\\ 2p-6x^2\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)=1,\ \left(\tfrac{-2}{p}\right)=\left(\tfrac{p}{7}\right)=-1\text{ and }2p=3x^2+14y^2,\\ 0\pmod{p^2}&\text{if }\left(\tfrac{-42}{p}\right)=-1.\end{cases}$$
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a published proof or disproof of these specific supercongruences for $\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\binom{2k}{k}^2 T_{2k}(18,1)/256^k$ and $\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\binom{2k}{k}^2 T_{2k}(30,1)/256^k$ modulo $p^2$. Related supercongruences of Z.-W. Sun on sums involving generalized central trinomial coefficients have been studied, but the status of these particular cases could not be confirmed.

status_evidence.title: Open Conjectures on Congruences (Z.-W. Sun)
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture A82 lists supercongruences for sums involving binomial squares and T_{2k}(18,1), T_{2k}(30,1) modulo p^2.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is stated as an open problem in Sun's list of conjectures.

status_evidence.title: Super congruences and Euler numbers
status_evidence.snippet: Studies related supercongruences modulo p^2 involving binomial sums.
status_evidence.claim: Related supercongruence framework, but does not address the specific T_{2k}(18,1) and T_{2k}(30,1) sums of Conjecture A82.
